title: Story premise ENT064: The Shadow With an Extra Arm
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: We hired three people. The wall hired four. Takeaway/theme: One silhouette can combine several separate sources.
description: A stagehand must find a supposed extra performer shown in a wall shadow, but the cast count is correct. A side view reveals that a coat-rack branch overlaps one actor’s shadow; moving the rack separates the silhouettes and gives the branch its own tiny bow.
